note: The directive for the Allied seat of rung 1 of the ladder (decision 0237). A placeholder: the command, the places, the ship and the men are invented, and the page shows each name without the word. Written for the game in its own words. The mission is the record's, as the designer confirmed it.

parts.heading: 1. Situation
text: You command at Base S. It has the stock, the fuel and one ship, Fast transport 1. Base T, 200 miles away, is the forward garrison. Each place has 1,000 men, who eat 5 t a day. There is no enemy within reach.

parts.heading: 2. Mission
text: Keep both garrisons fed. Every man, here and forward, is to be fed every night to the end of day 14. The forward garrison holds five days of food. Our own men eat from the stock you ship from, and it holds 5 t more than both need. Your one ship carries six days of the forward garrison's food at a time, and the fuel on hand is enough for two round trips.

parts.heading: 3. Guidance
text: Give the staff one order: keep Base T supplied. Name the ship, and Base S as its source, and set its two numbers: the days of food Base T is never to fall below, and the days more that each run brings. The staff does the rest: it sizes each run from those two numbers, loads the ship and sails her.
Then tell the staff that plans launch when ready, under YOUR ORDERS, and carry on: it will not sail the ship without that leave.
When day 14 is fought you are told whether the mission was met and, if it was not, which garrison went unfed and on which nights.
